name: pullback_momentum_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting pullbacks to VWAP or EMA in strong momentum stocks. Inefficiency from retail selling into strength. Survives via strict relative volume and index filter.
mechanism: In a trending market, pullbacks occur when short-term profit-taking temporarily overwhelms the dominant institutional flow. The pullback exhausts as profit-takers finish selling, and the underlying institutional buying resumes. The pullback low creates a higher-probability entry point because the macro flow direction remains intact.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: fails in strong trends without pullback
Slippage on fast moves: deep pullbacks turn into breaks
Crowding: pullback setups common on X
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
